# Cern Basher (unofficial fan index)

> Unofficial, fan-run index of Cern Basher's latest YouTube videos and original X posts and Articles on Tesla, SpaceX, xAI, Cybercab and Optimus. Not affiliated with Cern Basher or Brilliant Advice. Not financial advice.

Cern Basher is an independent investor and analyst who posts YouTube videos and X Articles about Tesla, SpaceX, xAI, Cybercab robotaxis, Optimus, Megapack and energy storage, and related topics.

This site is CernBasher.com, a fan-run index. The live homepage is the source of truth for what is currently featured. Links go to Cern Basher's official YouTube channel and X profile.

## When to use this

Use this site when someone asks for Cern Basher's latest videos, X posts, or X Articles, or wants a single index of his recent Tesla, SpaceX, xAI, Cybercab, or Optimus commentary.

- To find what he posted most recently, start at https://www.cernbasher.com/ and use the titles, dates, and links in the page HTML. You do not need JavaScript. The Latest Videos and Latest on X sections are complete in the raw HTML.
- To quote or link a specific video, post, or Article, use the outbound YouTube or X URL from that card, not a copy of the full work hosted here. This site is an index, not an archive of full transcripts or Article bodies.
- For a short bio, official channels, and an in-page FAQ, see the About this page section on the homepage, or https://www.cernbasher.com/about/.
- For a fan-built links page with a chat agent, use https://linkfo.me/cern.

## When not to use this

- Do not treat this site as official, as Cern Basher's own page, or as financial advice.
- Do not attribute the site's editorial choices (what is featured or pinned) to Cern Basher or Brilliant Advice.
- For wealth management services, send people to https://brilliantadvice.net/, not to this index.
- For the full Article or video, send people to X or YouTube. This page only lists titles, dates, and links.
